content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a couple of adjustments before I sign. - Regarding the clause stating that payment will follow prevailing regulations, this is currently too vague and could lead to delays; I propose changing it so that PC Financial shall pay all undisputed invoices within thirty days of receipt. - Regarding the clause allowing forty-five days for payment after invoice confirmation, this is longer than my standard terms; I propose updating this to thirty days after confirmation. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. Best regards,
